spec.command:
set -eu
7z x -y -o"$OUT/profile" store/jobs/j000052/out/contact.rar >/dev/null
find "$OUT/profile" -type f -printf '%s\t%p\n' | sort > "$OUT/files.tsv"
for f in "$OUT/profile"/contact/info.json "$OUT/profile"/contact/host.db "$OUT/profile"/contact/instance1/hostkeys "$OUT/profile"/contact/instance_db/hostkeys "$OUT/profile"/contact/instance1/config.dbx "$OUT/profile"/contact/instance_db/instance.dbx; do echo "==== $f"; file "$f"; xxd -l 256 "$f"; strings -a -n 4 "$f" | head -60; done > "$OUT/triage.txt"
sha256sum "$OUT/profile"/contact/instance1/config.dbx "$OUT/profile"/contact/instance_db/instance.dbx "$OUT/profile"/contact/instance1/hostkeys "$OUT/profile"/contact/instance_db/hostkeys > "$OUT/hashes.txt"
cat "$OUT/files.tsv" "$OUT/triage.txt" "$OUT/hashes.txt"

requester.name: DBX Key Examiner
requester.doing: Establishing Q14, the userkey of the encrypted DBX database, from unknown.data and memory artefacts.

accessible.access: read-only; this job's view: only what it declared
read-only; the run's tools: code, each sealed by its manifest's sha256

sensitive.note: run with secret_output: every output it sealed is sensitive
